analysis:
MARKET REGIME: SPY is in uptrend (+1.1% vs SMA50, positive slope). Constructive backdrop but not a reason to force new positions.

EXISTING POSITIONS REVIEW:
- AMP (+2.93%): Thesis intact. Quality financial with strong FCF and ROE. Hold.
- AON (-2.45%): Within normal noise for this name. Insurance brokerage quality thesis unchanged. Hold.
- MCO (+2.19%): Moody's performing well. Hold.
- RMD (-1.95%): Appears in today's screened list as UPTREND (basing) — no thesis break. Slightly underwater but within ATR. Hold.

None of the four positions have hit stops or broken thesis. No SELLs warranted today.

PORTFOLIO CONTEXT: Win rate of 9.1% and Profit Factor of 0.03x demand ruthless selectivity. Sortino of -9.12 reflects significant downside volatility. The lesson: only enter when setup is genuinely asymmetric. Headroom for one more position: ~$25,841 (buying-power constraint) and $24,484 (25% equity cap). This allows one additional position at most.

NEW TRADE RATIONALE: Broadridge Financial (BR) screens as the cleanest setup — 30% of 52-week range (lower third, Stage 1→2 transition territory), SMA50 slope turning sharply positive (+8.6% in 20 days), still -3.3% below SMA200 giving upside runway before resistance. Fundamentals are strong: ROE 40.9%, op margin 24.6%, $1.2B FCF, fwd P/E 14.57 — cheap for this quality. Analyst EPS revision +1.2% positive. Earnings not until Nov 3 (55 days out), giving time for the position to develop. Sector is Technology/financial infrastructure which diversifies from the financial-heavy existing book (AMP, AON, MCO). Risk/reward is genuinely asymmetric at 3.6:1. This is a basing-knife entry, not a falling-knife chase.

trades.entry_strategy: Limit order at $168.50 or better; accept fill on any intraday pullback to the SMA50 area. Do not chase above $172.
trades.rationale: FUNDAMENTAL: Broadridge is a dominant financial infrastructure/proxy-services business with a near-monopoly on shareholder communications processing. ROE 40.9%, operating margin 24.6%, $1.2B FCF, low capex intensity. Fwd P/E 14.57 is cheap relative to quality and SaaS-like recurring revenue mix. Revenue growing 7.5% with positive EPS revision. D/E 123 is elevated but manageable given predictable cash flows and long client contracts. TECHNICAL: Price at 30% of 52-week range — lower third, prime Stage 1→2 basing zone. SMA50 slope +8.6% in 20 days signals momentum shift. Still -3.3% below SMA200, leaving the 200MA as a natural magnetic target and subsequent resistance. Price held the $134 lows convincingly. Entry here is buying the base breakout attempt, not chasing a run.
trades.exit_plan: Stop hit at $160.06 (full exit, no averaging down). Exit if price closes two consecutive weeks below the SMA50 once the trend is established. Exit ahead of earnings (Nov 3) if position is not yet profitable and we are uncomfortable holding through the event. Target of $200 represents the SMA200 convergence zone and is realistic 2-4 months out. If thesis holds and LTCG boundary approaches (one year), reassess for tax-efficient hold extension.
